steps.code:
# Parse the note content to extract song titles and artists
content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the first line if it's the title "# Songs for Spotify Playlist"
if lines[0].startswith('#'):
    lines = lines[1:]
songs = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    # Split on " by " to get title and artist
    if ' by ' in line:
        title, artist = line.split(' by ', 1)
        songs.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artist': artist.strip()})
    else:
        # If no artist, just use title
        songs.append({'title': line, 'artist': ''})
print(songs)
